hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$file" ] && exit 0; case "$file" in *.env|*.env.*) pattern='.*' ;; */backend/*.go|backend/*.go) pattern='os\.Getenv' ;; */frontend/*.ts|*/frontend/*.tsx|frontend/*.ts|frontend/*.tsx) pattern='process\.env' ;; */.github/workflows/*.yml|.github/workflows/*.yml|*/.github/workflows/*.yaml) pattern='secrets\.|vars\.' ;; */infra/ansible/*|infra/ansible/*) pattern='extra-vars|from-literal' ;; */infra/k8s/*|infra/k8s/*) pattern='secretKeyRef|configMapRef|value:' ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; if [ "$pattern" = '.*' ] || grep -qE "$pattern" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"This edit touches environment variable usage/config. Run the env-vars-report skill to check for deploy-pipeline drift (a var read in code but missing from GitHub Actions/ansible/k8s, or wired but unused) before finishing this task."}}'; fi
